name: Eleazar (Jesus's ancestor)
title: Link in Jesus's genealogy
summary: Eleazar was the son of Eliezer and the father of Matthan in Matthew's genealogy, one of the links in Jesus's lineage between the testaments.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Eleazar is listed in Matthew's genealogy between Eliezer and Matthan.
